title: Proactive acceptance runway & aligned clearance lanes for PRD scope changes
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Create a lightweight, executable process (the 'acceptance runway') to reduce late-stage PRD rework by aligning engineering, design, and legal on scope changes, acceptance criteria, and sign-off timing. This ticket builds the runbook, a stoplight clearance matrix, and a short cadence for micro-decisions so PMs can get deterministic sign-offs for incremental PRD changes without blocking delivery. Include clear owners, SLAs per decision type, and template artifacts for PRD reviewers.
acceptance_criteria: Published runbook accessible from Confluence with step-by-step reviewer flow and required artifacts
Stoplight matrix (Green/Amber/Red) that maps change types to reviewer sets and expected SLA windows
Template PRD change checklist and one-click review packet that includes impacted telemetry & rollout plan
Pilot with two teams (Serving Runtime and Console) completed and feedback loop incorporated
Defined escalation path and on-call reviewer rotation documented (owner names and contact method)
tasks: Draft runbook skeleton and clearance matrix (PM)
Workshop with Eng/Design/Legal to validate matrix and SLA windows (invite list + agenda)
Create PRD change checklist and lightweight review packet generator (docs + template)
Implement pilot with Serving Runtime and Console teams; collect telemetry on review latency
Iterate on matrix thresholds and publish final runbook; add to PRD templates
